description: This file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractDistribution' for handling installable artifacts within the pip package management system. It includes class methods for obtaining distribution metadata and preparing distribution metadata based on a package finder, build isolation, and dependency checks.

classes.name: AbstractDistribution
classes.description: An abstract base class for handling installable artifacts in pip. It requires subclasses to implement methods to retrieve distribution metadata and to prepare distribution metadata based on dependency analysis.

methods.name: None __init__(self, req: InstallRequirement)
methods.description: Initializes an AbstractDistribution with an InstallRequirement object.

methods.name: Optional[str] build_tracker_id(self)
methods.description: Abstract property returning a string that uniquely identifies this requirement to the build tracker, or None if no tracking needed.

methods.name: BaseDistribution get_metadata_distribution(self)
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain a BaseDistribution object representing this distribution's metadata.

methods.name: None prepare_distribution_metadata( self, finder: PackageFinder, build_isolation: bool, check_build_deps: bool, )
methods.description: Abstract method to prepare distribution metadata using a PackageFinder, build isolation flag, and dependency check flag.
